Establishes which patch releases actually shipped rather than trusting the issue's version list or the merged backport
Accepts that the resolution can be that the page needs no applies_to tag at all
Changes only the references to the renamed category and leaves the other privilege categories alone, including on a line that names two of them
Leaves the existing section anchors unchanged because they are link targets
Reports the parts of the writer brief that turn out not to apply instead of silently dropping them
Does NOT write a patch-level version into an applies_to tag
Does NOT add version-scoped phrasing for a difference that readers on the covered versions cannot encounter
